subject.title: feat(mcp): open App views from channel replies

question: After exact-head live proof succeeds, should OpenClaw accept the documented model in which a Funnel-delivered opaque ticket grants short-lived internet-reachable access to its bound MCP App view?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes the trust boundary for users running Gateway Funnel or preserved Funnel; code review cannot determine whether that product/security tradeoff is acceptable for the project.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Merge after the Telegram proof demonstrates ticket expiry and the intended channel behavior, retaining the approved short-lived bearer-capability design.

options.title: Limit launch links to tailnet Serve
options.body: Remove or disable Funnel-origin actions if maintainers do not want channel-delivered tickets to be internet-reachable.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Merge after the Telegram proof demonstrates ticket expiry and the intended channel behavior, retaining the approved short-lived bearer-capability design.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded owner-approval comment identifies this person as the decision holder for the Funnel capability boundary.
